english.note: University current published scale; no conversion inferred. Degree/year of study inUS or solely English institution/country may exempt at department discretion.

applicationFee.note: Office of Admissions does not provide fee waiver.

requirements.note: Accredited bachelor and undergraduateGPA3.0 required; two semesters each general biology/chemistry plus one each organic chemistry,microbiology,biochemistry. Enter with predetermined professor/lab; no rotations. Department inquiry/advising encouraged before central application. TOEFL speaking4.5 forTA.

funding.note: On-campus PhD students receive undated$35,000annual departmental stipend and tuition waiver. Student fees approximately$700/semester and other uncovered costs are student responsibility. No departmental scholarships.
